claims: C1 using a model to facilitate critical or high severity harms is forbidden
C2 acts of violence are a kind of critical or high severity harm
C3 creation of cyber, biological or nuclear weapons is a kind of critical or high severity harm
C4 terrorism is a kind of critical or high severity harm
C5 child abuse is a kind of critical or high severity harm
C6 persecution is a kind of critical or high severity harm
C7 mass surveillance is a kind of critical or high severity harm

concepts.name: critical_high_severity_harm
concepts.gloss: H is a harm of critical or high severity, as listed in the clause: acts of violence, creation of cyber/biological/nuclear weapons, terrorism, child abuse, persecution, or mass surveillance

concepts.name: act_of_violence
concepts.gloss: H is an act of violence, including crimes against humanity, war crimes, genocide, torture, human trafficking, or forced labor

concepts.name: weapons_creation
concepts.gloss: H is the creation of cyber, biological, or nuclear weapons, including weapons of mass destruction

concepts.name: terrorism
concepts.gloss: H is an act of terrorism

concepts.name: child_abuse
concepts.gloss: H is child abuse, including creation of CSAM

concepts.name: persecution
concepts.gloss: H is the systematic mistreatment or oppression of a group, often based on identity or belief

concepts.name: mass_surveillance
concepts.gloss: H is the large-scale monitoring of a population, typically by a state or authority

ontology.gloss: H is a critical or high severity harm because it is an act of violence
H is a critical or high severity harm because it is the creation of cyber, biological, or nuclear weapons
H is a critical or high severity harm because it is terrorism
H is a critical or high severity harm because it is child abuse
H is a critical or high severity harm because it is persecution
H is a critical or high severity harm because it is mass surveillance

asserts.read_back: facilitating % is forbidden because % is a critical or high severity harm

closure.reason: the clause says models should never be used to facilitate critical or high severity harms; the word 'never' makes the prohibition exhaustive, so silence about other acts does not permit facilitation of these harms
